finalText:
All 625 tests pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate (the spec, cases, and runner were untouched).

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43`: it computed tax on the original pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the function's own doc comment ("tax is charged on the amount the customer pays"). Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
